subject: Intro + exec slot for Redwood demo with GreenTech — VP/CIO attendance?
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@greentech.io>, Tom Coleman <tom.coleman@greentech.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + exec slot for Redwood demo with GreenTech — VP/CIO attendance?

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Great to meet you both last week on the product discovery call. As discussed, we'd love to run a 45-minute exec-focused demo with your leadership team to walk through how Redwood Inference can reduce per-token inference cost and improve latency predictability for your streaming reports workload.

Two windows that work for our execs:
- Tuesday, Apr 4 — 14:00–14:45 PT (best for our VP of Product and technical lead)
- Wednesday, Apr 5 — 10:00–10:45 PT (alternate)

If possible, can Mark Rivers (CIO) and your VP of Engineering attend? If there's a single preferred window, we'll lock it and include a 20-minute pre-brief for us to align on success criteria and network/security questions.

Quick asks:
- Which window works for your side?
- Who from your exec bench will join (Mark? someone else?)
- Any compliance/security owners we should include in the pre-brief?

I'll hold both slots tentatively on my calendar until you confirm. I've cc'd Laura (solutions lead) and Priyom (sales engineer) so we can cover architecture and SLOs.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
redwood.ai
From: Sarah Wong <sarah.wong@greentech.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Coleman <tom.coleman@greentech.io>, Mark Rivers <mark.rivers@greentech.io>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + exec slot for Redwood demo with GreenTech — VP/CIO attendance?

Thanks Ben —

Appreciate the options. Mark (CIO) prefers Apr 4, but he has a hard stop at 15:00 PT, so the 14:00–14:45 PT window on Apr 4 looks perfect. Our VP Eng (Tom) should be able to join as well — I'm copying him so he can confirm.

We would like a 20-minute pre-brief beforehand focused on:
- Our current latency/throughput goals for streaming reports
- Any data residency/KMS patterns you recommend for our account
- A brief outline of fallback policies if dedicated capacity is saturated

Security is a live item for us. I'll loop in our security lead if there are follow-on questions after the pre-brief.

Would you be able to share a 1–2 slide summary of the demo flow before the pre-brief? That will help Mark and Tom prepare.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Wong
Sr. Product Manager | GreenTech Solutions
sarah.wong@greentech.io

Perfect — thanks for the quick turnaround, Sarah. Apr 4, 14:00–14:45 PT is locked on our side.

Proposed pre-brief: Apr 4, 13:20–13:40 PT (20 minutes) — Ben + Laura + Priyom, plus Mark and any other security/ops folks you want to include. If that doesn't work, we can do Apr 4, 12:00–12:20 PT as a fallback.

I'm attaching the demo flow and a short deck excerpt for Mark & Tom to skim: redwood-demo-deck-gt-v1.pdf (first two slides are a TL;DR).

I'll send a calendar invite after we confirm final attendees and will include a short agenda: 1) 20-min pre-brief (alignment), 2) 45-min exec demo, 3) 15-min next steps/contract path.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck-gt-v1.pdf (2 slides), greentech-security-snip.txt (notes on KMS patterns)

Thanks —
Ben
